description_en: Queries a list of NAT IP addresses
description_zh: 调用ListNatIps接口查询NAT IP地址列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-nat-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-gw8v16wgvtq26vh590000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNatIps

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway instance to which the NAT IP addresses belong.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的NAT IP地址列表所属NAT网关实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the NAT gateway to which the NAT IP addresses belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询NAT IP地址所属NAT网关实例ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block to which the NAT IP addresses belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的NAT IP地址所在的地址段
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询NAT IP地址列表。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses RequestId as ClientToken. The value of RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The status of the NAT IP addresses to query. Valid values:

Available: available.
Deleting: being deleted.
Creating: being created
parameters.help_zh:
查询的NAT IP地址的状态。取值：

Available：可用状态。
Deleting：删除中。
Creating：创建中
parameters.name: nat_ip_status

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAT IP address to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的NAT IP地址的名称。N取值为1~20
parameters.name: nat_ip_name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the NAT IP address to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的NAT IP地址实例ID。N取值为1~20
parameters.name: nat_ip_ids

parameters.help_en:
The origin of the NAT IP address to query. Valid values:
prefix: a NAT IP address that belongs to an IP prefix.

cidr: a standalone NAT IP address that does not belong to any IP prefix.

Empty: queries all NAT IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的NAT IP来源的属性枚举。可能值：
prefix：属于IP前缀的NAT IP。

cidr：不属于任何IP前缀的孤立NAT IP。

空：查询全部NAT IP
parameters.name: ip_origin

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the IP prefix to query
parameters.name: ipv4_prefix

NatIps.description_en: The list of NAT IP addresses

Ipv4Prefix.description_en: The CIDR block of the IP prefix to which the NAT IP address belongs
Ipv4Prefix.description_zh: 查询的NAT IP地址所属的IP前缀地址段

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the NAT IP address is the default one. Valid values:

true: The NAT IP address is the default one.

false: The NAT IP address is not the default one
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否是默认NAT IP地址。取值：

true：是默认NAT IP地址。

false：不是默认NAT IP地址

NatGatewayId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the NAT IP address belongs
NatGatewayId.description_zh: 查询的NAT IP地址所属的VPC NAT网关实例ID

NatIpCidr.description_en: The CIDR block to which the NAT IP address belongs
NatIpCidr.description_zh: 查询的NAT IP地址所在的地址段

NatIpDescription.description_en: The description of the NAT IP address
NatIpDescription.description_zh: 查询的NAT IP地址的描述信息

NatIpId.description_en: The instance ID of the NAT IP address

NatIpName.description_en: The name of the NAT IP address
NatIpName.description_zh: 查询的NAT IP地址的名称

NatIpStatus.description_en:
The status of the NAT IP address. Valid values:

Available: available.
Deleted: deleted.
Deleting: being deleted.
Creating: being created.
Associated: associated with an SNAT or DNAT entry.
Associating: being associated with an SNAT or DNAT entry
NatIpStatus.description_zh:
查询的NAT IP地址的状态。取值：

Available：可用状态。
Deleted：已删除。
Deleting：删除中。
Creating：创建中。
Associated：已关联SNAT或DNAT条目。
Associating：关联SNAT或DNAT条目中

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of NAT IP addresses returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的NAT IP地址结果数目
